83000   An assessed income period (AIP) is a period specified by a DM during which the
        amount of a claimant’s retirement provision is fixed subject to deemed increases
        made in accordance with the relevant legislation1.
                                                                                             1 SPC Act 02, s 7(4)


        Note: No new AIPs will be set on, or after 6.4.161. As a consequence, claimants will
        be expected to report all relevant changes in their circumstances, including their
        retirement provision. Accompanying changes to existing, fixed period and some
        indefinite period AIPs are described in this chapter.
                            1 Pensions Act 14, s 28; Pensions Act 2014 (Commencement No. 5) Order 2015. s 2(2)(b)
